name: Limo, chauffeur and party bus

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Brewery tour seat (21+)
services.story: The main story: a brewery tour seat from the garage lot, $69, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Free vehicle viewing
services.story: A free vehicle viewing at the garage: nothing taken, nothing to pay.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Wedding stretch limo, 4 hours
services.story: The main story: a wedding stretch limo, 4 hours: $720 with the 20% gratuity. A 25% deposit ($180) with the contract; the $540 rest is charged to the saved card when Marco texts DONE.

services.name: Airport transfer, flat
services.story: An airport transfer, $125 flat: a card saved for a $60 late-cancel fee; the $125 charged when the chauffeur texts DONE.

services.name: Prom package
services.story: A prom package, $850, paid in full when the parent signs and books.

services.name: Custom party bus night
services.story: A custom party bus night, quoted from the route at $1,200: a $300 deposit with the contract, the $900 rest charged to the saved card at DONE.

services_shape: event: a vehicle and a chauffeur for a date and a span of hours, along a route of a pickup, stops and a drop-off; hourly with a minimum, or a flat transfer; the vehicle is the capacity, with a chauffeur licensed for it. Flow A: tour seats from the company's own lot, and a free vehicle viewing
questions_before_times: the date, the pickup time, and how many hours (or one way)
the kind of trip: a wedding, a prom, a birthday, an airport ride, a night out, a funeral
how many passengers (it sets the vehicle)
the pickup town and kind of place, the stops, and the last drop-off
whether any passenger is under 21 (no alcohol on the trip) or under 18 (the prom rules, car seats)
for an airport pickup: the flight number
safety_stop: someone hurt or in danger right now
license: where the state's or the local for-hire authority's rules require it: a for-hire passenger carrier permit for the business (a livery, limousine or charter-party permit), each vehicle registered and inspected for for-hire use; a business registration everywhere
staff_skills: sedan and SUV, stretch limo, party bus, airport meet and greet, weddings, proms (two years with the company, its own rule), funerals
messages_never: a prom passenger list, ages, a child's details, a passenger's health or accessibility needs and any money details never go in a text: only the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
